# Top Dynamos

> Top Dynamos is a publishing house on Long Island, New York. It writes and publishes the careers of top professionals: biographies, personal websites, registry profiles, press releases and hardcover publications. Reputation management is a separate service.

Every biography, website and press release is written from the person's own documents and approved by them, in writing, before anything is published. Paid recognition is always labeled as paid. Pricing is shared at a consultation and is not published on the site.

## Services

- [Publishing](https://topdynamos.com/publishing): biographies, personal websites, press releases and the four publishing packages (Career Spotlight, Achievement Showcase, Crystal Distinction, Legacy Collection)
- [Biographies](https://topdynamos.com/professional-branding): professional biographies written from the person's records
- [Personal websites](https://topdynamos.com/personal-websites): a website under the person's own name
- [Press releases](https://topdynamos.com/press-releases): paid, company published releases, not independent news coverage
- [Publications](https://topdynamos.com/publications): digital and hardcover publications, including the Top Dynamos Book
- [Recognition](https://topdynamos.com/recognition): awards and certificates included in paid packages for clients who meet eligibility
- [Reputation management](https://topdynamos.com/reputation-management): a separate monthly service
- [All services](https://topdynamos.com/services)

## Who it serves

- [Top Doctors](https://topdynamos.com/physicians)
- [Top Executives](https://topdynamos.com/executives)
- [Other top professionals](https://topdynamos.com/professionals)
